title: The Station That Closed Badly: Shutting Down in the Reverse of Starting, Past a Step That Fails, Once, and the Deletes That Never Ran
fallback: This lesson is about closing a program down, so it needs Qt. Lesson 02-03 is about destructors that run in a fixed order, lesson 07-07 about threads that must be joined, and lesson 03-10 about a destructor that did not run, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a list of the things a program has started, closed in the reverse of the order they started, each even if another failed, and only once
